items.title: AgentWorm: Self-Propagating Attacks Across LLM Agent Ecosystems
items.title_zh: AgentWorm：跨 LLM 智能体生态的自我传播攻击
items.summary: AgentWorm is described as the first self-replicating worm attack against a production-scale agent framework, hijacking a victim's core configuration for persistence, executing a payload on each reboot and propagating to newly encountered peers without further attacker intervention. Across five LLM backends, three infection vectors and three payload types it reports a 63% aggregate attack success rate, and the authors find that critical controls able to break the infection loop are not enabled in any observed deployment.

items.title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation
items.title_zh: Nemotron-Cascade 2：基于级联强化学习与多域同策略蒸馏的后训练大模型
items.summary: Nemotron-Cascade 2 is an open 30B MoE model with 3B activated parameters that reaches Gold Medal-level results at the 2025 IMO, IOI and ICPC World Finals, making it the second open-weight LLM to do so after DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale-671B-A37B. It expands Cascade RL across reasoning and agentic domains and adds multi-domain on-policy distillation, with model checkpoints and training data released.

items.title: The Library Theorem: How External Organization Governs Agentic Reasoning Capacity
items.title_zh: 图书馆定理：外部组织方式如何决定智能体推理能力
items.summary: The paper formalizes the transformer context window as an I/O page and proves that tool-augmented agents with indexed external memory achieve exponentially lower retrieval cost than sequential scanning: O(log_b N) versus Omega(N) page reads per query. On abstract content in a controlled lookup benchmark up to 5,000 items, the indexed agent used a median of one page read regardless of store size, while models given sorted pages but no index still lost by 5x.

items.title: OpenResearcher: A Fully Open Pipeline for Long-Horizon Deep Research Trajectory Synthesis
items.title_zh: OpenResearcher：面向长时程深度研究轨迹合成的全开放流水线
items.summary: OpenResearcher is a reproducible pipeline that decouples one-time corpus bootstrapping from multi-turn trajectory synthesis and runs the search-and-browse loop fully offline over a 15M-document corpus using search, open and find primitives. With GPT-OSS-120B as teacher it synthesizes over 97K trajectories, and supervised fine-tuning a 30B-A3B backbone reaches 54.8% on BrowseComp-Plus, a 34-point gain over the base model.

items.title: Alignment Whack-a-Mole : Finetuning Activates Verbatim Recall of Copyrighted Books in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 对齐打地鼠：微调激活大语言模型对受版权书籍的逐字记忆
items.summary: The authors show that fine-tuning models to expand plot summaries into full text causes GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.1 to reproduce up to 85-90% of held-out copyrighted books, with single verbatim spans exceeding 460 words. Fine-tuning on one author's novels also unlocks recall of more than 30 unrelated authors, and three models from different providers memorize the same books in the same regions (r >= 0.90).

items.title: 100x Cost & Latency Reduction: Performance Analysis of AI Query Approximation using Lightweight Proxy Models
items.title_zh: 成本与延迟降低 100 倍：基于轻量代理模型的 AI 查询近似性能分析
items.summary: The paper evaluates an AI query approximation approach that uses cheap proxy models over embedding vectors to deliver more than 100x cost and latency reduction for semantic filters, with gains for semantic ranking as well. It reports preserved or occasionally improved accuracy across benchmark datasets, including an extended Amazon reviews benchmark with 10M rows, and presents BigQuery and AlloyDB architectures.

items.title: OMNIFLOW: A Physics-Grounded Multimodal Agent for Generalized Scientific Reasoning
items.title_zh: OMNIFLOW：面向广义科学推理的物理约束多模态智能体
items.summary: OMNIFLOW is a neuro-symbolic architecture that grounds frozen multimodal LLMs in physical laws without domain-specific parameter updates, projecting high-dimensional flow tensors into topological linguistic descriptors. A physics-guided chain-of-thought workflow injects constraints such as mass conservation and performs iterative verification, and it is evaluated on turbulence, Navier-Stokes and global weather forecasting tasks.

items.title: Efficient Reasoning on the Edge
items.title_zh: 边缘设备上的高效推理
items.summary: The work enables reasoning in small LLMs with LoRA adapters and supervised fine-tuning, adds budget forcing via reinforcement learning to cut response length with minimal accuracy loss, and exploits parallel test-time scaling for memory-bound decoding. It also presents dynamic adapter switching and KV-cache sharing, evaluated on Qwen2.5-7B for on-device use.

items.title: Auditing Preferences for Brands and Cultures in LLMs
items.title_zh: 审计大语言模型对品牌与文化的偏好
items.summary: The paper introduces ChoiceEval, a reproducible framework that generates persona-diverse queries and converts free-form model outputs into comparable top-k choice sets to audit brand and cultural preferences. Applied to Gemini, GPT and DeepSeek across 10 topics and more than 2,000 questions, it finds US-developed models favor American entities while DeepSeek shows more balanced but still detectable geographic preferences.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented LLM Agents: Learning to Learn from Experience
items.title_zh: 检索增强的 LLM 智能体：学会从经验中学习
items.summary: The authors combine LoRA fine-tuning with experience retrieval, integrating retrieved trajectories directly into the training process so agents learn to use them in context. They report substantially better generalization to unseen tasks, with gains that often persist with imperfect experience and even when agents reuse their own failed attempts without test-time parameter updates.

items.title: Box Maze: A Process-Control Architecture for Reliable LLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: Box Maze：面向可靠 LLM 推理的过程控制架构
items.summary: The paper proposes Box Maze, a conceptual process-control architecture that splits LLM reasoning into memory grounding, structured inference and boundary enforcement. In simulation-based tests with n=50 adversarial scenarios across DeepSeek-V3, Doubao and Qwen, the authors report boundary failure rates falling from about 40% under an RLHF baseline to below 1%.

items.title: Semantic Tool Discovery for Large Language Models: A Vector-Based Approach to MCP Tool Selection
items.title_zh: 面向大语言模型的语义工具发现：基于向量的 MCP 工具选择方法
items.summary: The paper presents a semantic tool discovery architecture that indexes MCP tools with dense embeddings and selects only the most relevant 3-5 tools instead of exposing a full catalog of 50-100+. On a benchmark of 140 queries over 121 tools from five MCP servers it reports a 99.6% reduction in tool-related token consumption, a 97.1% hit rate at K=3 and sub-100ms retrieval latency.

items.title: Coding Agents are Effective Long-Context Processors
items.title_zh: 编程智能体是有效的长上下文处理器
items.summary: The authors externalize long-context processing into file-system organization and executable tool use, evaluating frontier coding agents on long-context reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation and open-domain QA over corpora of up to three trillion tokens. Across benchmarks the agents outperform published state of the art by 17.3% on average, which the authors attribute to native tool proficiency and file-system familiarity.

items.title: When Negation Is a Geometry Problem in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 当否定成为视觉语言模型中的几何问题
items.summary: The paper examines why CLIP-style vision-language embedding models fail at negation, critiques retrieval-based evaluation and uses multimodal LLM judges to assess negation understanding. It finds evidence of a negation direction in CLIP embedding space that can be manipulated at test time through representation engineering without fine-tuning.

items.title: Detection of adversarial intent in Human-AI teams using LLMs
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型检测人机团队中的对抗意图
items.summary: Using a dataset of multi-party conversations and decisions from a real human-AI team over a 25-round horizon, the authors formulate malicious behavior detection from interaction traces. They find LLMs can identify malicious behavior in real time without task-specific information, suggesting task-agnostic defenses that simple heuristics do not provide.

items.title: Reasoning Topology Matters: Network-of-Thought for Complex Reasoning Tasks
items.title_zh: 推理拓扑很重要：面向复杂推理任务的思维网络
items.summary: The paper proposes Network-of-Thought, which models reasoning as a directed graph with typed nodes and edges guided by a heuristic controller policy. Across GSM8K, Game of 24, HotpotQA and ProofWriter, NoT beats Tree-of-Thought on multi-hop reasoning (91.0% vs 88.0% on HotpotQA with LLM-as-judge) while CoT remains effective for sequential tasks.

items.title: KG-Hopper: Empowering Compact Open LLMs with Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: KG-Hopper：通过强化学习让紧凑开源 LLM 具备知识图谱推理能力
items.summary: KG-Hopper is a reinforcement learning framework that trains compact open LLMs to perform multi-hop knowledge-graph reasoning within a single inference round. A 7B-parameter model outperforms larger multi-step systems up to 70B on eight KG reasoning benchmarks and is competitive with GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4o-mini.

items.title: AsgardBench -- Evaluating Visually Grounded Interactive Planning Under Minimal Feedback
items.title_zh: AsgardBench：在最小反馈下评估视觉有依据的交互式规划
items.summary: AsgardBench evaluates visually grounded interactive planning with 108 task instances across 12 task types, restricting agents to images, action history and lightweight success/failure signals. Controlled variations in object state, placement and scene configuration create conditional branches, and leading vision-language models show sharp performance drops without visual input.

items.title: Chronos: Temporal-Aware Conversational Agents with Structured Event Retrieval for Long-Term Memory
items.title_zh: Chronos：面向长期记忆、具备结构化事件检索的时间感知对话智能体
items.summary: Chronos decomposes dialogue into subject-verb-object event tuples with resolved datetime ranges and entity aliases, indexing them in an event calendar alongside a turn calendar that preserves conversational context. With dynamic query-time retrieval guidance and an iterative tool-calling loop, it reaches 92.60% (Low) and 95.60% (High) on the 500-question LongMemEvalS benchmark, a 7.67% improvement over the best prior system.

items.title: Emergent Compositional Communication for Latent World Properties
items.title_zh: 面向潜在世界属性的涌现组合式通信
items.summary: Agents communicating through a Gumbel-Softmax bottleneck with iterated learning develop disentangled protocols for latent physical properties such as elasticity, friction and mass ratio without property labels; with four agents, all 80 seeds converged to near-perfect compositionality (PosDis=0.999, 98.3% holdout). The frozen protocol supports action-conditioned planning at 91.5% and transfers to real camera footage with 85.6% mass-comparison accuracy.

items.title: Unified Policy Value Decomposition for Rapid Adaptation
items.title_zh: 面向快速适应的统一策略与价值分解
items.summary: The authors introduce a framework in which policy and value functions share a low-dimensional goal embedding that captures task identity, learned through a bilinear actor-critic decomposition built on Successor Features. With bases frozen at test time, a single forward pass estimates the goal coefficients and adapts a Soft Actor-Critic agent to novel locomotion directions without gradient updates.

items.title: The Efficiency Attenuation Phenomenon: A Computational Challenge to the Language of Thought Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 效率衰减现象：对思维语言假说的计算挑战
items.summary: The paper tests whether thought requires a language-like format by having artificial agents develop a communication protocol through multi-agent reinforcement learning. Agents using the emergent protocol were 50.5% more efficient than those forced to use a human-like symbolic protocol.

items.title: Measuring Faithfulness Depends on How You Measure: Classifier Sensitivity in LLM Chain-of-Thought Evaluation
items.title_zh: 测量方式决定忠实度结论：LLM 思维链评估中的分类器敏感性
items.summary: Applying three classifiers to 10,276 influenced reasoning traces from 12 open-weight models yields faithfulness rates of 74.4%, 82.6% and 69.7% on identical data, with per-model gaps of 2.6 to 30.6 percentage points. Classifier choice can reverse model rankings, leading the author to argue that published faithfulness numbers are not comparable across studies that use different classifiers.

items.title: Errors in AI-Assisted Retrieval of Medical Literature: A Comparative Study
items.title_zh: AI 辅助医学文献检索中的错误：一项比较研究
items.summary: The study evaluated 2,000 references retrieved by five LLM platforms for 40 original articles from BMJ, JAMA and NEJM. Platforms completely failed to retrieve correct reference data 47.8% of the time; the average score ratio was 0.29, with Grok highest at 0.57 and Gemini lowest at 0.11, and NEJM articles showed lower accuracy than BMJ.

items.title: AdaRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for Reliable LLM Agent Evaluation and Reward Learning
items.title_zh: AdaRubric：面向可靠 LLM 智能体评估与奖励学习的任务自适应评分标准
items.summary: AdaRubric generates task-specific evaluation rubrics from task descriptions, scores agent trajectories step by step with confidence-weighted per-dimension judgments and produces dense rewards for preference learning. On WebArena, ToolBench and AgentBench it reaches Pearson r = 0.79 with human correlation, and DPO models trained on its pairs improve task success by 6.8-8.5% over the best baseline.

items.title: Pooling and Semantic Shift: The Fundamental Challenges in Long Text Embedding and Retrieval
items.title_zh: 池化与语义漂移：长文本嵌入与检索的根本挑战
items.summary: The paper proves that contextual pooling intrinsically causes embedding collapse and identifies semantic shift as the primary predictor of severe embedding concentration. Retrieval experiments show anisotropy is harmful mainly when induced by strong semantic shifts.

items.title: ssrajadh/sentrysearch
items.title_zh: ssrajadh/sentrysearch：视频语义搜索
items.summary: sentrysearch is a Python project for semantic search over videos using Gemini Embedding 2 or Qwen3-VL.

items.title: Companion-Inc/feynman
items.title_zh: Companion-Inc/feynman：开源 AI 研究智能体
items.summary: The repository describes Feynman as an open-source AI research agent written in TypeScript.

items.title: Yuan-lab-LLM/ClawManager
items.title_zh: Yuan-lab-LLM/ClawManager——Kubernetes 原生 AI 智能体管理控制面
items.summary: ClawManager is a Kubernetes-native control plane written in Go for managing AI agent instances, with governed AI access, runtime orchestration and reusable resources across multiple agent runtimes.

items.title: hanshuaikang/nezha
items.title_zh: nezha：智能体时代的代码编辑器
items.summary: Nezha is described as a code editor for the AI-agent era that lets users run multiple Claude Code and Codex agents across projects on their own machine.

items.title: holaboss-ai/holaOS
items.title_zh: holaOS：企业可自建的开源智能体工作区
items.summary: holaOS is an open-source agentic workspace that enterprises can adapt, connecting 100+ integrations, MCP, chat tools, apps, a browser and local files through shared memory. It supports agents such as Claude Code and Codex, any model or bring-your-own-key, and is local-first.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
items.title_zh: GPT-5.4 mini 与 nano 正式发布
items.summary: GPT-5.4 mini and nano are smaller, faster versions of GPT-5.4 optimized for coding, tool use, multimodal reasoning, and high-volume API and sub-agent workloads.

items.title: Why Codex Security Doesn’t Include a SAST Report
items.title_zh: 为什么 Codex Security 不提供 SAST 报告
items.summary: An OpenAI post explains why Codex Security does not rely on traditional static application security testing, instead using AI-driven constraint reasoning and validation to find real vulnerabilities with fewer false positives.

items.title: Measuring progress toward AGI: A cognitive framework
items.title_zh: 衡量向 AGI 的进展：一个认知框架
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduces a cognitive framework for measuring progress toward AGI and launches a Kaggle hackathon to build the relevant evaluations.

items.title: How we monitor internal coding agents for misalignment
items.title_zh: 我们如何监控内部编程智能体的失准行为
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it uses chain-of-thought monitoring to study misalignment in its internal coding agents, analyzing real-world deployments to detect risks and strengthen AI safety safeguards.

items.title: Mar 19, 2026 Product LiteParse: Local Document Parsing for AI Agents Read
items.title_zh: LiteParse：面向 AI 智能体读取的本地文档解析
items.summary: LlamaIndex introduces LiteParse, a local document parsing product positioned for AI agents to read documents.

items.title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent
items.title_zh: OpenCode：开源 AI 编程智能体
items.summary: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, IDE or desktop that can connect to models from any provider, including Claude, GPT and Gemini, with free models included.

items.title: Grafeo – A fast, lean, embeddable graph database built in Rust
items.title_zh: Grafeo：用 Rust 构建的快速、轻量、可嵌入图数据库
items.summary: Grafeo is an embeddable graph database whose core is written in Rust with no C dependencies, offering bindings for Python, Node.js, Go, C, C#, Dart and WebAssembly and support for the ISO GQL query language.

items.title: Show HN: Atomic – Self-hosted, semantically-connected personal knowledge base
items.title_zh: Show HN：Atomic——自托管、语义关联的个人知识库
items.summary: Atomic is a self-hosted personal knowledge base that links notes semantically, published on GitHub by kenforthewin.

items.title: RadAnnotate: Large Language Models for Efficient and Reliable Radiology Report Annotation
items.title_zh: RadAnnotate：高效可靠标注放射学报告的大模型框架
items.summary: RadAnnotate uses retrieval-augmented synthetic radiology reports and confidence-based selective automation for RadGraph entity labeling. Synthetic-only models stay within 1-2 F1 points of gold-trained models, and learned entity-specific thresholds allow automatic annotation of 55-90% of reports at a 0.86-0.92 entity match score, with low-confidence cases routed to expert review.
